production.note: US model years. First: Ford's '2012 FORD MUSTANG BOSS 302 TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS'. 2013: Ford's 2013 Mustang brochure lists the Boss 302 (ford-2013-mustang-brochure). Last: the end year rests on CJ Pony Parts' '2012-2013 Ford Mustang Boss 302 Guide' (cjpp-boss-302-guide, an enthusiast source); no opened Ford page says 2013 was the last year. The Boss 302 Laguna Seca is a separate trim and not part of this record.

body.note: Inferred from Ford's sheet for the two-door Mustang; Cars.com names the style '2dr Cpe Boss 302' (cars-com-boss-302-2013-specs). No convertible Boss 302 was listed.

aspiration.note: Inferred from the brochure's description of the Hi-Po 302 Ti-VCT V8 (no forced induction mentioned).

fuel.note: Inferred from the brochure's description of the petrol V8.

drivetrain.note: Inferred from Ford's sheet for the front-engine, rear-drive Mustang.

transmission.note: 'Standard Six-speed manual'. The 2013 brochure: '6-speed manual transmission'. The only transmission.

powerHp.note: 2013 model year. Quote: "Hi-Po 302 Ti-VCT V8 engine with 444 hp @ 7,400 rpm and 380 lb.-ft. of torque @ 4,500 rpm". Ford's 2012 technical specifications gave a preliminary "Horsepower 440 (est.)" (ford-2012-boss-302-tech-specs); Cars.com lists the 2013 car at "444 @ 7400" (cars-com-boss-302-2013-specs).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL: a database and an enthusiast source, matching Ford's estimate. Boss 302 coupe, 6-speed manual (the only car), 2013 model year. Cars.com: "Base Curb Weight: 3,631 lbs" for the '2dr Cpe Boss 302'. Ford's 2012 sheet gives the same figure as an estimate: "Manual transmission 3,631 (est.)" (ford-2012-boss-302-tech-specs, a manufacturer estimate). CJ Pony Parts' guide (C.J. Tragakis) gives "3,632 lbs" for the 2012 to 2013 car (cjpp-boss-302-guide, an enthusiast source). No final Ford figure was found.

discrepancies.reason: Ford's 2012 sheet gave a preliminary estimate ('440 (est.)'); the published rating is 444 hp.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 444 hp, Ford's final rating in the 2013 brochure.

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 3,631 lb rests on Cars.com (a database) and Ford's 2012 technical specifications, which label it '(est.)'; CJ Pony Parts (an enthusiast source) gives 3,632 lb. A final Ford figure (a later Ford technical-specifications sheet or press kit) or a Car and Driver, Road & Track or MotorTrend spec panel would replace it. The end year (2013) rests on CJ Pony Parts; a Ford page would confirm it.
